children: Greenlight Capital Re appointed John Welch as an independent director of its Registrant Board and Greenlight Re Board, effective September 1, 2026, and named him to the Audit, Compensation and Underwriting Committees.
Independent Director; member, Audit Committee, Compensation Committee, Underwriting Committee

Age 61; former Group Chief Underwriting Officer at Aspen (Jul 2025–Feb 2026); reinsurance executive at Sompo until Aug 2026; prior roles at Aspen, AXA XL Reinsurance, XL Catlin, XL Reinsurance America; Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society; B.S. Math, Fairfield University.
Appointed to Audit Committee, Compensation Committee and Underwriting Committee
